title: Large Language Models and Modern AI
summary: In June 2017 researchers at Google described the transformer, a neural network built entirely on attention mechanisms, without the recurrent or convolutional layers then standard, presented at the NeurIPS conference that year. A transformer turns each word of a text into a token and maps how every token relates to every other, which helps it use context when generating text. Transformers became the basis of large language models such as those behind ChatGPT, which brought generative AI into wide public use.

uncertainty.note: June 12, 2017 was the original preprint publication date of the landmark Attention Is All You Need paper on arXiv.
